_about: One entry per team mascot, keyed by the team's short name in lower case. `prompt` is what Tripo was given (model tripo-p2, pbr=false); only the costume and accessories differ between them. The banana came first, from a shorter prompt; the others spell out what it happened to get (black limbs, white gloves and sneakers, big white eyes). `source` is the raw model under assets/stadium/source/tripo/. `joints` may override what tools/prep_mascot.py finds: name -> [x, y, z] with height = 1 and front = -Y, names as that script prints them after JOINTS.
